[Chorus: male voice sung, hymn-like, voices behind]
They brought me back, they brought me back
Four minutes gone, and they brought me back
I heard my name from a long way off
Lord, I wasn't ready, and they brought me back

[Verse 1: calm male rap, matter-of-fact]
Tuesday, half past six, I'm making eggs
Felt a hand close up inside my chest
Next thing is the ceiling and the tile
My daughter on the phone, eleven, dialed
She did the counting like they told her on the line
Thirty and two, thirty and two, the whole time
Sirens. Boots. A stranger's hands, a shout
Somebody said "clear" and the lights went out

[Chorus: male voice sung, hymn-like, voices behind]
They brought me back, they brought me back
Four minutes gone, and they brought me back
I heard my name from a long way off
Lord, I wasn't ready, and they brought me back

[Verse 2: same calm, a little warmer]
Woke up Thursday with a tube and a scar
A nurse named Dee said, "There you are"
I asked her what I owed. She laughed. She said
"Walk. Eat green things. Go to bed."
Now I take the stairs. I take the pills. I take my time.
I learned the medic's name. I sent her wine.
My girl won't talk about it. She just checks
My breathing through the door. I let her. That's respect.

[Bridge: choir humming, voice spoken low]
Forty-four. Every day since is extra.
I don't waste extra.

[Final Chorus: full choir, organ]

I heard my name from a long way off
Lord, I wasn't ready, and they brought me back
